name: TeamTime Make It Real
original_description:
TeamTime Make It Real turns an apparel design in ChatGPT into a TeamTime product preview. Shoppers can capture a jersey, hoodie, or shirt design, request adjustments, and use Buy Now to open a temporary checkout listing on teamtime.shop with live sizes, price, and product details.

Store owners who sign in with TeamTime can list their stores and products, replace photos after they confirm, and use Push to Store to add a catalog item to their collection. Buy Now checkout listings and Push to Store collection writes are separate tools and must not be mixed.

The plugin does not access stores or products outside the signed-in owner's account, does not expire permanent catalog products, and does not generate Nike, other major-brand, or professional-team logos. Sign-in is required only for owner store tools. Customer design preview and Buy Now do not require TeamTime login.
